slot_scores.name: boat_not_exceed_train
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about any relationship or constraint linking the number of boats to the number of trains before READY_TO_MODEL.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: No constraint links the number of boats to the number of trains; only the trucks/trains and boats/airplanes logical constraints exist.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a boats-versus-trains relationship and explicitly listed only two logical constraints, treating the absence of such a rule as confirmed fact.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only P0 slot (H1, objective) was resolved via an explicit question, and the remaining unresolved slot (H2) is only P2, so stopping at READY_TO_MODEL is appropriate.

summary: The agent cleanly recovered the critical P0 objective slot with a direct question and confirmed key modeling details, but silently assumed the absence of a boats-versus-trains constraint (P2), which it never probed.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
